Class ImageDocument

java.lang.Object
ImageDocument
public class ImageDocument extends Object
Holds the image being edited plus drawing state shared across tools. Backing pixels live in backing. The base canvas shows the current image; tools draw onto this canvas via commit(Consumer, Rectangle2D). A transparent overlay sits above for live previews.

Features: - Undo/Redo using full-image snapshots (simple & reliable) - Selection rectangle & in-app image clipboard - Stroke color/width & dashed properties bound to UI - Dirty tracking & display name

      public void commit(Consumer<javafx.scene.canvas.GraphicsContext> painter, javafx.geometry.Rectangle2D dirtyRect)

      Parameters:

      dirtyRect - Region affected (currently informational; kept for future optimization).
